about.text: A semi-soft cheese from Yeghegnadzor in Armenia, made from milk set with rennet, brined, crumbled and mixed with local herbs and seeds. It is packed into clay pots and buried in the mountains to ripen, which gives its name, "buried" cheese. Sources give the ripening as about three months or as six.
